'''Thomas Graham''' (also published as '''Tom Graham''') played the [[2012 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://starwarsccg.org/phocadownload/2012/2012mpcday1.pdf 2012 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> He also played the [[2012 Canadian Nationals]].<ref name="pc-cn2012">[https://starwarsccg.org/phocadownload/2012/CanadianNationals2012Decklists.pdf 2012 Canadian Nationals], starwarsccg.org</ref>
